<!-- generated by harness-summit; edits are overwritten by `harness-summit install` -->

Call the `summit_rename` tool of the harness-summit MCP server with `name` set to the user text after the command: `$ARGUMENTS`. If that text ends with `--force`, remove `--force` from the name and also pass `force` set to true.

Report the new name in one short line.
